rules.sentence: Postfracture nonunion leaves the scaphoid's proximal portion susceptible to ischemia and avascular necrosis.
Concern for preventing nonunion has made 7-to-8-week thumb spica casting the standard treatment for scaphoid fractures.
Traumatic injuries cause sprains and tendon ruptures, while repetitive use and overuse contribute to tendinopathies, such as tendinitis, tendinosis, and tenosynovitis.
